propositions: Function-scoped rebar_repo fixture runs per-test subprocess-heavy initialization (mkdir, git init, git config, rebar.init_repo, git commit) consuming 306ms and 58 spawns, accumulating to 47% of tests/interfaces tier wall-clock (361.4s setup vs 391.0s call)
Build rebar_repo template once per xdist worker session-scoped, then copytree with symlinks=True per test, reducing initialization from 306ms to 22.3ms (13.7x speedup)

Worktree pointer fix-ups required after copy: rewrite .tickets-tracker/.git and .git/worktrees/*/gitdir absolute paths; bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op that leaves copies reading template refs
Per-test REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR and regenerated .env-id and .signing-key prevent snapshot store collision on single template SHA and enforce environment-specific signature validity
Template fixture must build in isolated MonkeyPatch.context with REBAR_ROOT set, XDG_CONFIG_HOME cleared, and config cache reset to prevent test-local autouse environment contamination
